title: selaginella denticulata
intro: Selaginella denticulata, commonly known as Spiked Spike Moss, is a type of evergreen, terrestrial plant belonging to the family Selaginellaceae. It has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help alleviate conditions like arthritis and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Selaginella denticulata include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve immune function, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. Research has identified bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to the plant's medicinal properties.
